posts.zh:
dsh-sleep-send 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。在输入框右侧提供「定时发送」按钮与配置面板，支持智能时段、自定义日期时间、多个定时任务并行，任务经 localStorage 持久化，刷新页面后自动恢复。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-a3bf16b41f19c77f792d.html
posts.en:
dsh-sleep-send is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Schedule-send button and panel to the right of the composer, with smart time slots, a custom date/time picker, several queued sends at once, and localStorage persistence that restores pending tasks after a page reload.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-a3bf16b41f19c77f792d.html
